Since - 1992
‘Shreeyog Builders & Developers’ a construction 
company was formed with a vision to change the face 
of property development in Nashik. The firm have 
built a solid reputation with rock solid experience 
more than 28 years in building Luxurious Residential 
& Commercial Projects at Mumbai Naka, Bhabha 
Nagar, Gangapur Road, Govind Nagar, Indira 
Nagar, Deepali Nagar, Kamathwada, Bodhale 
Nagar,  Rane Nagar & Rajiv Nagar in Nashik.
‘Shreeyog Builders & Developers’ constant in 
meticulous planning, superior design, amenities, 
excellence in quality and timely completion have 
made them synonymous with quality construction & 
reliability. We build your home on four aspects that 
embossed the symbol of Quality Construction, 
Transparent Deal, Customer’s Satisfaction & Social 
Awareness. We always beleive in creating a whole 
new way of comfort and luxury living. Understanding 
customer needs is what has driven us to create 
residential projects equipped with all lifestyle 
amenities that today’s customer requires.
Luxury You Truly Deserve
page_03:
At 'ShreeVenkatesh Park' we build it to perfection, 
seamlessly blending casual comfort with thoughtful 
and smart conveniences with all lifestyle amenities 
that today’s customer requires.
Created for you at 'ShreeVenkatesh Park' the perfect 
location and chic amenities make these homes 'a 
dream come true’.
Even the vastly-travelled would agree that there is 
nothing like the welcoming warmth of a home. No 
matter what your circumstances or identity outside, 
when you're home; all you need is oodles of 
comfort and pampering. No matter how much you 
achieve in life, there is nothing compared to a 
warm home to come back to.
No matter what your dreams or ambitions, your 
mind shall always be at peace and your heart cozy 
only in your very own home.

SPECIFICATIONS & AMENITIES
2 & 3 BHK Luxurious Flats
SHREE 
Venkatesh
P A R K
• Brick work done is natural red soil brick or Eco 
light block.
• L shape or parallel granite kitchen platform with 
full dodo. 
• All door shutters of bedroom and main door are 
with laminate for both sides.
• 3 Track anodised Sliding Windows with mosquito 
net.
• Good quality of M.S. security gate for main door.
• All toilets and windows with granite frame.
• Provision for inverter wiring for entire home .
• Net metering for common light (no common light 
bill).
• Provision for A/C conduit .
• Each toilet with full dado.
• Flooring 800 by 800 vitrified of well known brand
• Provision of separate overhead water tank for 
flushing purpose to save NMC water.
• ISI mark PVC plumbing material and Jaguar 
fittings. 
• Geyser system in every toilet.
• Curtain rods with curtains for entire home.
• Automatic 6 person lift with genset backup .
• Entire home enlightened with tube light set, bulbs, 
fan and aquaguard, shoe rack, etc.
• Entrance lobby with safety gate .
• Provision of false ceiling in hall. 
• CCTV surveillance.
• Cloth dryer stand for each home.
• Mirror arrangement on basin area and bath 
accessories for each flat.
• Separate parking for each home.
• Kitchen trolley in SS make .
• Internal colouring tractor emulsion & external 
paint apex (Asian paints) weather protect.
• Separate letter box and nameplate for each 
home.
• Common TATA sky
• Watchman room with toilet.
• Top terrace with one basin and water 
arrangement for small party or get together.
